entry.note: New bib entry for Blitvić's 'Two-Parameter Non-Commutative Central Limit Theorem' (arXiv:1205.4003, the wrongly-fetched PDF at uploads/blitvic2012.pdf). Currently uncited in QOU (the existing 9 blitvic2012 citation sites all reference the OTHER Blitvić paper, 'The (q,t)-Gaussian process'). The PDF now has a canonical bib home; can be renamed to uploads/blitvic2012-clt.pdf in a follow-up upload-branch commit, or left in place pending decision.

relevance.rationale: INFRA: file absent from HEAD and the working tree; exists only on origin/claude/upload-bib-papers-2026-05-19 (intake commit 71a5b76aa0). Recovered from git history. Identity confirmed from the document's own cover (arXiv:1205.4003v1, two-parameter non-commutative central limit theorem, single author) — the join to blitvic2012-clt is CORRECT, and the ref() note at references.ts:5869 already flags that this PDF is the CLT paper rather than the (q,t)-Gaussian one. Citation status: the key blitvic2012-clt has ZERO citation sites anywhere in content/ — a bib orphan. Meanwhile the sibling key blitvic2012 carries FIVE sites, and the load-bearing one is mis-located: folio/quantum-observable-universe/braids-and-knots/hecke-satisfies-blitvic-hypothesis-proof.md:82 concludes the proof with 'This matches Blitvic's (q,t)-Gaussian moment formula [`blitvic2012`, eq. (1.2)] at parameter (q, t = 1)'. VERIFIED against this document: the crossing/nesting moment formula sum_{V in P_2(2n)} q^{cross(V)} t^{nest(V)} ... is Theorem 2, equation (12) HERE; and this document numbers its equations flat ((1),(2),...,(14)), so an 'eq. (1.2)' does not exist in it. The (q,t)-Gaussian paper the key blitvic2012 names is NOT uploaded, so the corpus's one load-bearing Blitvic locator is currently unverifiable from the corpus's own sources while an equivalent, verifiable statement sits unused in this upload. Separately, folio/quantum-observable-universe/lean/QOU/Observations/QCltNonCommutative.lean:25-26 is internally inconsistent: it gives the (q,t)-Gaussian title and journal volume/pages but attaches the arXiv URL 1205.4003, which is THIS document — a live conflation of the two keys inside the file whose entire subject is a q-CLT.

keyResults.statement: For a sequence satisfying the generalised commutation relation with E(mu)=q t^{-1}, E(mu^2)=1, the limiting mixed *-moments of the normalised partial sums are sum over pair partitions V of P_2(2n) of q^{cross(V)} t^{nest(V)} times the product term; odd moments vanish.
keyResults.useForFolio: At t = 1 this is exactly the moment formula the Hecke-Blitvic proof block needs, with a locator that actually exists. It is also the literature statement the conditional q-CLT class in QCltNonCommutative.lean should cite, since that class is about a CLT and the currently-cited key is not the CLT paper.

(12) at t=1, which the corpus can verify from its own uploads.

QOU/Observations/QCltNonCommutative.lean:25-26 pairs the (q,t)-Gaussian title/journal with the arXiv id of the CLT paper — the two keys are conflated in one reference line, in the file whose subject is precisely a non-commutative CLT. The CLT key blitvic2012-clt is the correct citation there.
